The breach is a planning-level drift between Wave 4's stated invariant ('SuSiE-RSS layer NOT touched under RSID scope') and the Snakemake DAG's transitive-rebuild semantics. Three forward paths exist (restore vs accept vs widen-scope), each with different epistemic/manuscript implications. The executor agent does NOT have authority to choose between them.
